facts: BrainVault v3 contract: 0xDb8230f5A2859fCa29E0ae6C8521784c1a34DC90 (current vault). The older vault is 0x0126...1D31 and its cards stay readable.
Card references use the form vN:id, e.g. v3:6.
Wave Genesis v1 contract: 0xfe33d2b4279ec269f4beca499c7a7b704ab54397 on Theta mainnet.
Wavey gives 5 free questions per day; Wavey is reached at wave.theta and bots.oswave.io/wavey.
Wave sites: oswave.io, app.oswave.io, web.oswave.io, bots.oswave.io.
Wavey card set on BrainVault v3: design v3:5, listing v3:6, knowledge cards v3:7 to v3:50.
Wavey's replies are written by a chat model running off-chain (Theta EdgeCloud models), grounded in his public cards.

questions.q: How many free questions can I ask you per day?
What is the chain ID of Theta mainnet?
Which BrainVault vault version is current, and can older cards still be read?
questions.reference: v3 is the current vault; older v2 cards remain readable.

An AI whose weights and code live in a smart contract on Theta mainnet; any input (a .theta name, wallet or word) deterministically produces a unique 20x20 bot, and the same input always gives the same bot.

questions.q: Where do your answers come from?
questions.reference: From Wavey's public knowledge cards minted on BrainVault on Theta, so answers can be checked against those cards.
